subject: Confirmation of flight booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on December 15, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: AB123, Departure: 10:00 AM, Arrival: 3:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need to make changes, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
